title: Edit result template

resultTemplateRequired.title: Result template is required
resultTemplateRequired.message: Before you can save the survey, you need to configure the result template that will be shown to respondents after they complete it.

noSourcesYet: No questions or calculated values in this survey yet.
pickQuestionOrCalculated: Pick a question or calculated value

statusLabels.label: Status labels
statusLabels.help: Shared across every widget. The widget's value range is split into this many tiers, each showing its label.

imageField.embedded: Uploaded and saved in the form. Paste a URL to use a linked image instead.
imageField.tooLarge: This image is over {max}. Upload a smaller one or paste a link to it.
imageField.notImage: Pick an image file (PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF).
imageField.failed: The upload failed. Try again, or paste a link to the image.

images.help: A banner, an illustration for each status tier, or a diagram. Images for a tier show only when the score lands in it.
images.altHelp: Describes the image for screen readers. Leave it empty if the image is only decoration.
images.caption: Caption

actions.help: Up to two primary or secondary buttons share a row; with more, primary ones get their own row on top. Text buttons go last.
actions.empty: No buttons: respondents only see their result.
actions.label: Label
actions.urlHelp: Put a question's or calculated value's name in braces to add its answer: https://example.com/book?score={'{'}riskScore{'}'}
actions.urlInvalid: Use an http(s)://, mailto: or tel: address.
actions.idHelp: The app gets this id when the button is clicked.
